about: Where each cost and tax component of a simulated trade must be verified, kept apart by who sets it. Document facts only: no rate, fee or tax value is recorded here. status: verified (document retrieved and its identity and effective date read), located (the document is identified but not retrieved), blocked (the publisher refused or did not answer this session), not-located (no primary document identified yet). Checked 2026-10-28.

components.applies_to: gains on sale of equity-oriented ETF units
components.document: Income-tax Act, 1961, sections 111A and 112A as amended by the Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024
components.notes: India Code and incometaxindia.gov.in answered HTTP 403; egazette.gov.in did not answer. Secondary sources report amendments effective for transfers from 2024-07-23; unverified. Whether a newer Income-tax Act applies to later years must also be checked at the primary source.

components.applies_to: purchase and sale of ETF units on an exchange
components.document: Finance (No. 2) Act, 2004, Chapter VII (Securities Transaction Tax), as amended
components.notes: Which rate applies to equity-oriented ETF units, and on which side of the trade, must be read from the Act as amended for each year in the window.

components.authority: Parliament of India / Government of India
components.document: Indian Stamp Act, 1899 as amended by the Finance Act, 2019, and the Indian Stamp (Collection of Stamp-Duty through Stock Exchanges, Clearing Corporations and Depositories) Rules, 2019
components.notes: The commencement date of the uniform stamp-duty regime must be taken from the gazette notification.

components.applies_to: brokerage, exchange transaction charges and SEBI fees
components.authority: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs
components.document: Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), 28 June 2017 (G.S.R. 690(E)), as amended
components.notes: Identified from secondary references (Phase 2.2); the official PDF and the consolidated amendments were not retrieved. The applicable entry and rate for each year of the window must be read from the notification as amended at that time.

components.applies_to: how exchange and depository charges are passed to clients
components.authority: Securities and Exchange Board of India
components.document: SEBI/HO/MRD/TPD-1/P/CIR/2024/92, Charges levied by Market Infrastructure Institutions - True to Label, July 01, 2024
components.notes: Paragraph 7: effective from October 01, 2024. Sets the structure (uniform charges, the amount collected from clients equal to what the institution receives), not the charge values; values before and after that date come from the exchanges' own circulars.

components.authority: Securities and Exchange Board of India
components.document: Securities and Exchange Board of India (Payment of Fees) (Amendment) Regulations, 2019, dated 2019-03-22, and any later amendment in the window
components.notes: SEBI's regulations listing shows the 2019-03-22 amendment; its PDF was not retrieved and its notification number is unconfirmed. A sebi.gov.in PDF offered by search for it turned out to be a different regulation (SEBI/LAD-NRO/GN/2018/31) and was not used.

components.document: NSE circulars on transaction charges (including revisions effective 2024-10-01)
components.notes: The NSE archive host closed connections from this session.

components.document: BSE notices on transaction charges for the equity cash segment (including any revision around 2024-10-01)
components.notes: BSE notice pages are retrievable by number (sources.json bse-notice); the relevant notice numbers were not identified. News reports describe a September 2024 revision that changed derivatives charges; the cash-segment position is unconfirmed.

components.applies_to: debit of units from a demat account on sale
components.document: CDSL DP Tariff structure 2025 (debit transaction tariff with effect from 2024-10-01)
components.notes: Verified for 2024-10-01 onward only: the depository's charge to the DP, not the client-facing DP charge, which adds the broker's own amount (below). CDSL tariffs for 2018 to 2024-09-30 were not located; nsdl.co.in did not answer. No value recorded.

components.applies_to: the reference broker's own brokerage and DP charge
components.notes: HTTP 200 on 2026-10-28. Shows current values only; historical values for 2018-2026 need dated versions. Primary only for Zerodha's own charges, secondary for every statutory, regulatory or exchange item above.
